errorCard.title: Error
errorCard.description: Unable to load your profile information. Please try again later.

admin.title: Administrator
admin.text: You have access to all administrative features on the site.

moderator.title: Moderator
moderator.intro: As a moderator, you can manage the site's content.

member.title: Member
member.intro: Welcome to your member area. Enjoy all available features.

avatarPage.p1: An avatar is a small image used to help visitors recognize you easily. It must be square, with a standard size of 96x96 pixels and a maximum file size of 200 KB.
avatarPage.p2: Last point, if the image contains content that may be deemed offensive or inappropriate for visitors, the administrator reserves the right to remove the avatar.

editPassword.intro: To update your password, fill out the fields below. Make sure to use a strong new password.

new.label: New password
new.policy: 8–30 chars, with 1 uppercase, 1 number, and 1 special: ()!@#$%^&*_-
new.hint: Use a strong password: 8–30 chars, uppercase, number, special.
new.different: New password must be different from current password

toast.error: An error occurred while updating your password.

avatar.label: Image file
avatar.size: File size must be less than 200KB
avatar.type: Only jpg and png files are allowed
